title: bot.ability.vision.description.input
description: One encoded image file, exactly as its producer captured or received it, to describe.

image.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the encoded image file in the media directory the run grants, standing for the original's image bytes; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
image.title: Image

media_type.description: Media type of the encoded bytes, such as image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp; null when the source did not name it.
media_type.title: Media Type
